prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. For the record, I'll note that you've declined to state your name at this time. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was on the main road in League City, Texas, heading toward the freeway. I was moving over into the right lane because I needed to make my exit.

Q: Had you signaled before you changed lanes?

A: Yes, I put my turn signal on a good while before I moved over. I checked my mirror and my blind spot too.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car was in that lane, a bit back, and when I started to move over, it sort of drifted into me. We sideswiped. My side mirror clipped their rear quarter panel and then my car got pushed toward the curb.

Q: Did you lose control of your vehicle?

A: For a second, yeah. I jerked the wheel to correct and I hit the brakes. The car stopped against the curb.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My right wrist took the brunt of it. I grabbed the steering wheel and the airbag came out, and I felt something snap right away. They took me in and the doctor said it was a fracture.

Q: Have you received treatment since then?

A: Yes, I've had a cast put on and I have a follow-up scheduled with an orthopedic specialist. I'm not able to drive much right now, so that's been hard.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was following the rules and I think the other driver should be responsible for the damage.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
